test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. One of them contains an error. Select the segment that contains the error from the given options.

The people of / Jammu and Kashmir / has emphasised and / appreciated transparency.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**has**" used with the plural noun "**people**."
 
• For plural nouns, the correct verb form should be "**have**" instead of "has".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**have emphasised and**", ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"The people of Jammu and Kashmir have emphasised and appreciated transparency."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "The people of"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "Jammu and Kashmir"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **1: "appreciated transparency"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
